recent.title: Pick up where you left off
recent.body: Your recent searches live here. Load one to tweak it, or run it again as it was.

route.title: Where are you headed?
route.body: Enter where you're flying from and to. Add stops on the way for a multi-city trip.

interests.title: Tell us what you love
interests.body: Your interests and the discovery dial shape every recommendation — from famous classics to hidden gems.

preferences.title: We remember your details
preferences.body: Nationality, visas, travelers and interests you use here are saved to Preferences, and they pre-fill this form next time.

plan.title: Watch your trip come together
plan.body: Flights, hotels, visa, weather and more stream in section by section — the first results appear within seconds.

myPlan.title: Build your plan
myPlan.body: Add the flights, hotels and activities you like to My Plan, see where the money goes, then add it to your calendar or save it as a PDF. Chat is there for any question along the way.

hero.title: Plan Your Perfect Trip
hero.subtitle: Flights, hotels, activities, visa, SIM & itinerary — all in one place.
hero.tour: New here? Take a quick tour

drop.title: Drop it to plan a trip

lisbon.label: 48 hours in Lisbon
lisbon.text: 48 hours in Lisbon: lunch at Time Out Market, Belém Tower and custard tarts at Pastéis de Belém, browse LX Factory, sunset at Miradouro da Senhora do Monte, then a day trip to Pena Palace in Sintra.

tokyo.label: A friend's Tokyo tips
tokyo.text: Tokyo musts from my trip!! Tsukiji Outer Market for breakfast, teamLab Planets (book ahead), Senso-ji at dawn before the crowds, drinks in Golden Gai, and Shibuya Sky at sunset. If you have time, Hakone for the onsen.

rome.label: Rome and Florence
rome.text: Day 1–2 Rome: Colosseum, dinner in Trastevere, the Pantheon, gelato at Giolitti. Day 3–4 Florence: the Uffizi, climb the Duomo, Piazzale Michelangelo at sunset and lunch at Mercato Centrale.
